title: Eligible new Commons audio appears as attributed Apricity samples
description:
Feature: Additional Commons sound and electronic audio

Scenario: Import eligible direct audio members from focused sound categories
  Given Commons categories cover ambient music, drum and bass, sound effects, drum patterns, drum sounds, musical instrument sounds, and synthesizer sounds
  And the existing Commons catalog may already contain files from those categories
  When the curated import runs
  Then each Commons file is represented once by stable page identity
  And every admitted file has analyzed sample audio and Recording and Sample links in production
  And supported licenses, creator credits, source URLs, and file revisions remain visible and auditable
  And video, unsupported, or incomplete-rights candidates are reported with a reason and excluded
